files_summary.openlibrary.json: Open Library catalog: 83 real books by 40 real authors across classic literature, sci-fi/fantasy, modern fiction, nonfiction, children's, and poetry. Four keyed collections with consistent cross-references (books_by_title ISBN -> books_by_id; book author_name -> authors_by_name/author_info).
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: open-library_get_book_by_title
tool_schemas.description: Searches Open Library for books matching the provided title and returns the matching results, caching retrieved metadata in Hearthstone Bibliographic Gateway for later reuse. It refuses requests where the title is missing or blank because it cannot perform a meaningful search. It may also refuse titles that are excessively long or otherwise invalid for lookup to prevent malformed or abusive queries.

title.description: The title of the book to search for.

tool_schemas.name: open-library_get_authors_by_name
tool_schemas.description: Searches Open Library for authors matching the provided name and returns a list of matching author records, caching retrieved metadata in Hearthstone Bibliographic Gateway. It refuses requests where the name is missing or blank because an author search cannot be performed. It may also refuse names that are excessively long or otherwise invalid for lookup to prevent malformed or abusive queries.

name.description: The name of the author to search for.

tool_schemas.name: open-library_get_author_info
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves detailed author metadata from Open Library for the given author key (for example, an OL…A key) and returns the author record, caching retrieved metadata in Hearthstone Bibliographic Gateway. It refuses requests where author_key is missing or blank, or where the key format is not a valid Open Library author key, because it cannot resolve the author. It also refuses requests for author keys that do not exist on Open Library or cannot be retrieved at the time of the request.

author_key.description: The Open Library key for the author (e.g., OL23919A).

tool_schemas.implementation:
_DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0453000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0453000") else "/app/database")
def open_library_get_author_info(author_key):
    import json, os
    db = json.load(open(os.path.join(_DB, 'openlibrary.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
    key = (author_key or '').replace('/authors/', '').strip('/')
    info = db['author_info'].get(key)
    return info or {'error': 'author ' + str(author_key) + ' not found'}

tool_schemas.name: open-library_get_author_photo
tool_schemas.description: Builds and returns the URL for the author photo associated with the provided Open Library author OLID, using Open Library’s author photo conventions. It refuses requests where the olid is missing or blank, or where the value is not a valid author OLID, because it cannot form a correct author-photo reference. It also refuses when no photo is available for that author identifier.

olid.description: The Open Library Author ID (OLID) for the author (e.g. OL23919A).

tool_schemas.name: open-library_get_book_cover
tool_schemas.description: Builds and returns the URL for a book cover image using the provided identifier type (key), identifier value, and optional size. It refuses requests where key or value is missing or blank, or where key is not one of the supported identifier types, because it cannot determine how to look up the cover. It also refuses when size is provided but not one of the supported sizes, or when no cover is available for the given identifier.

key.description: The type of identifier used (ISBN, OCLC, LCCN, OLID, ID).

size.description: The desired size of the cover (S, M, or L).

tool_schemas.implementation:
def open_library_get_book_cover(key, value, size='L'):
    return {'cover_url': 'https://covers.openlibrary.org/b/' + str(key).lower() + '/' + str(value) + '-' + str(size) + '.jpg'}

tool_schemas.name: open-library_get_book_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves detailed book metadata from Open Library for the given identifier type and value (isbn, lccn, oclc, or olid) and returns the book record, caching retrieved metadata in Hearthstone Bibliographic Gateway. It refuses requests where idType or idValue is missing or blank, or where idType is not one of the supported types, because it cannot resolve the identifier. It also refuses requests for identifiers that do not exist on Open Library or cannot be retrieved at the time of the request.

idType.description: The type of identifier used (ISBN, LCCN, OCLC, OLID).

tool_schemas.implementation:
_DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0453000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0453000") else "/app/database")
def open_library_get_book_by_id(idType, idValue):
    import json, os
    db = json.load(open(os.path.join(_DB, 'openlibrary.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
    k = str(idType).upper() + ':' + str(idValue)
    book = db['books_by_id'].get(k)
    return book or {'error': 'book ' + k + ' not found'}

metadata.name: Hearthstone Bibliographic Gateway
metadata.description: Fetches book and author details from a public library metadata source and caches the retrieved records, photos, and cover images for fast local reuse.
